tasks.short: Inspect sites for code and safety adherence.

steps.what: Monitor construction sites and the construction operations there against the safety standards.
Inspect those construction sites for adherence to the building codes and the specifications.
Write the inspection finding on that adherence so the record can ensure the safety standards, building codes, or specifications she judged.

tasks.design: She monitors the construction operations on site, then inspects them for the safety standard, the building code, and the specification. She writes the inspection finding herself. The design drafts no compliance judgement and does not write that finding for her.
tasks.previous_blocker: Whether the work on this site meets the safety standard does not reduce to a stored rule.
tasks.enabler_now: Faster coding does not walk the site or judge the building code.
tasks.still_hard: A missed defect can harm people, and the finding is hard to undo once the work is covered.
tasks.human_edge: She sees the operation and decides whether it meets the specification.
tasks.altitude: Her week on this task does not change. She still monitors the site and still writes the inspection finding.

reach.task: Name the operation underway on this one site.
reach.learn: Which operation is underway, so she does not judge a stage the crew has not reached.

evidence.claim: Judging adherence to a safety standard, a building code, or a specification on a construction site stays with the inspector. Meter bills, customer answers, and energy labels are a different job.

assumptions: The site walk stays on the site. She writes the inspection finding afterwards for the inspection record and does not send that finding outside the organisation.
The two site steps are 40 and 24 because the in-person means share is 63.2. The finding step is 36, covering documents, screens, mail, and the workbook.
There is no structured input. She produces the finding from what she saw. Nothing is added, so the upkeep allowance is zero. The design adds no location mark and no time stamp.
unknowns: Whether this employer already stores the inspection finding in a permit record a colleague maintains.
research_questions: Which safety standard applies to the operation she is watching before she writes the finding.

incremental.description: No upkeep. She adds nothing that needs a field list.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On a day she inspects a site she still monitors the operations, still judges the building code, and still writes the finding, so the saving on this task is zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Confer on regulations and remedial actions.

steps.what: Confer with owners, violators, or authorities to explain regulations and recommend remedial actions.
Write her conference note naming the owners, violators, or authorities, the regulations she had to explain, and the remedial actions she recommended.

tasks.design: She confers in the room with the owner, the violator, or the authority, explains the regulation, and recommends the remedial action. She writes the conference note herself afterwards. The design prepares no speaking script and does not transmit a notice outside the organisation.
tasks.previous_blocker: Which remedial action fits this violator depends on what she sees and on the regulation she has to explain.
tasks.enabler_now: Faster coding does not hold the conference with the owner or the authority.
tasks.still_hard: A wrong remedial action can become a legal dispute, and she cannot unsay it in the room.
tasks.human_edge: She explains the regulation and recommends the remedial action to the person in front of her.
tasks.altitude: Her week on this task does not change. She still confers and still writes the conference note.

reach.task: Name the specification clause for this one detail.
reach.learn: Which clause applies, so the remedial action matches the specification.

evidence.claim: Explaining a regulation and recommending a remedial action stays a conference with the owner, the violator, or the authority. An answer desk for energy questions is not this conference.

assumptions: The conference stays in the room. She writes the conference note afterwards for her own record and does not send that note outside the organisation.
The conference step is 65 because the in-person means share is 64.4. The note step is 35, covering documents, screens, mail, and the workbook.
There is no structured input. She produces the recommendation in the conference. Nothing is added, so the upkeep allowance is zero.
unknowns: Whether the authority expects a written notice after the conference.
research_questions: Which regulation she must explain before she recommends the remedial action.

incremental.description: No upkeep. The conference and the note stay as they are.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On a day she confers she still explains the regulation, still recommends the remedial action, and still writes the note, so the saving on this task is zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

tasks.short: Keep daily logs and inspection photographs.

steps.what: Take the photographs on site that will supplement the inspection records.
Maintain daily logs that say what those photographs show.
Attach each photograph in the inspection records beside the daily log she maintained.

tasks.design: She takes the photographs on site, maintains the daily log herself, and attaches each photograph in the {DOCS} record beside that log. The design does not generate the daily log and does not place the photographs.
tasks.previous_blocker: What a photograph shows on this site is situational, and the daily log has to say that.
tasks.enabler_now: Faster coding does not take the photograph or decide what the daily log should say.
tasks.still_hard: A daily log that misstates the photograph can support a legal dispute later.
tasks.human_edge: She chooses the photograph and writes the daily log that matches it.
tasks.altitude: Her week on this task does not change. She still takes the photographs and still maintains the daily log.

reach.task: Confirm which area the photograph shows on this one site.
reach.learn: Which area the photograph shows, so the daily log does not place it on the wrong record.

evidence.claim: Keeping the daily log and the photographs stays with the inspector. A records app of job, hours, and materials tied to invoicing is an energy job record, not this inspection record.

assumptions: The inspection record lives in {DOCS}. Named fields are the daily log text, the photograph, and the inspection record she already keeps. She produces all three. If the record will not take the photograph, she attaches it by hand beside the same daily log.
The photograph step is 41 because the in-person means share is 40.5. The daily log step is 42, covering the document share. The attach step is 17, covering screens, mail, and the workbook.
She already keeps this record, so nothing new is configured and the upkeep allowance is zero. The design adds no location mark and no time stamp. Test the native record before any custom code.
unknowns: Whether the inspection record already accepts a photograph beside the daily log.
research_questions: Which photograph belongs to which daily log entry before she attaches it.

incremental.description: No upkeep. She keeps using the inspection record she already writes, with no new field.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On a day of inspection records she still takes the photographs, still writes the daily log, and still attaches them herself, so the saving on this task is zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

steps.what: Decide how she will train, direct, and supervise the other construction inspectors.
Train, direct, and supervise those other construction inspectors on site using that decision.

tasks.design: She decides the direction, then trains, directs, and supervises the other construction inspectors on site. The design does not build a lesson and does not score the supervision.
tasks.previous_blocker: How to train and direct another inspector depends on the person and on the site that day.
tasks.enabler_now: Faster coding does not supervise the other construction inspector.
tasks.still_hard: Poor direction can lead the other inspector into work that harms people.
tasks.human_edge: She decides what to train and she directs the other inspector on site.
tasks.altitude: Her week on this task does not change. She still decides the direction and still supervises on site.

reach.task: Name the inspection the other inspector will do next on this one site.
reach.learn: Which inspection is next, so the direction matches the work still ahead.

evidence.claim: Training, directing, and supervising other construction inspectors stays with the inspector on site.

assumptions: She decides the direction before she meets the other inspectors, and the supervision stays on site. She does not send a score outside the organisation.
The direction step is 32 because the non-meeting means share is 32.5. The supervision step is 68 because the in-person means share is 67.4.
There is no structured input. She produces the direction herself. Nothing is added, so the upkeep allowance is zero.
unknowns: Whether a separate training task at this employer already covers the lesson she gives.
research_questions: Which inspection the other inspector will do next before she directs it.

incremental.description: No upkeep. Supervision stays in person, with nothing new to maintain.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: On a day she supervises she still decides the direction and still trains the other inspectors on site, so the saving on this task is zero.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

role.altitude: She still monitors construction sites for the safety standard and the building code, still confers on remedial actions, still keeps the daily log and the photographs, and still trains the other inspectors. Nothing is drafted for her.
reach: The construction supervisor names the operation underway on one site this inspector is monitoring.
The plans examiner names the specification clause for one detail this inspector is judging.
skills_to_grow: Judging whether site work meets the safety standard and the building code.
Explaining a remedial action to an owner or a violator.
Writing a daily log that matches the photographs she took.
role.ambitious_version: She still makes the site judgement, the remedial recommendation, the daily log, and the supervision herself. The site visits stay on the site.
